examples.arabic: أنا وأختي روحنا بيت تيتا إمبارح.
examples.english: My sister and I went to grandma's house yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ana w okhti ro7na beit teeta embare7.

examples.arabic: احنا عايزين نروح بيت تيتا النهاردة
examples.english: We want to go to grandma's house today.
examples.transliteration: ehna aayzeen nerooh beit teta el naharda

examples.arabic: وصلت سارة عند تيتا وقالت السلام عليكم يا تيتا ازيك
examples.english: Sara arrived at Grandma's and said, "Hello Grandma, how are you?"
examples.transliteration: Waṣalit Sara ʿand Tīta wa qālit As-salāmu ʿalaykum ya Tīta izzayyik?

examples.arabic: وصلت بيت تيتا دلوقتي ومبسوطة اني شفت كل العيلة
examples.english: I arrived at Grandma's house now and I'm happy I saw all the family.
examples.transliteration: Waṣalt bēt tēta dilwa'ti w mabsūṭa innī shuflit kull el-ʿēla.

examples.english: Grandma says "Get someone to fix it".

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا تيتا نورا دخلت المطبخ وهي بتقول السلام عليكم
examples.english: "Good morning, Grandma." Noura entered the kitchen saying "peace be upon you."
examples.transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Teta. Noura dakhalit el-matbakh we hiyya bat'ool as-salam alaykum.
